text: If the duke made any reply to this, Vittoria did not hear it. Now they entered the long gallery where they dispersed and wandered around, admiring and commenting on the glowing hues and barbaric splendours of the tapestries Doria had brought back from Lepanto. We must talk further'he said in a low urgent voice.'Where?
